name: Obstacle cancels the power-up
expected: Tick 1: dust on the start cell: Clean = clean_up.
Tick 2: at (4,3) obstacle (4,2) ahead: Disable Move Forward, Clean = clean_off, Turn Left. The power-up is cancelled after 1 tick (C11).
Tick 5: turn done: Forward + clean_on (the cancelled power-up is not resumed).
Tick 6: dust at (3,3): a new power-up, Clean = clean_up.
Tick 9: wall ahead at (0,3): the front is checked first, so Turn Left + clean_off (front before the power-up end).
function_text: EF-12 – Dust: power-up (clean_up) for 3 ticks, then back to clean_on
EF-14 – An obstacle during power-up cancels the power-up
EF-06 – Avoidance: turn left, left has priority when both sides are free
EF-09 – Cleaning stopped (clean_off) only while turning or reversing
EF-18 – Front obstacle has priority over dust
